purpose: Source-indexed public capability inventory for benchmark planning; not a certification, procurement assessment, or comparative performance result.

entries.status_as_reported: NeMo Agent Toolkit deprecated October 2026; EOL by end of 2026. Migration guide identifies NeMo Relay, NeMo Helix, and NeMo Fabric as successor components.
claim_notes: Migration guide describes Relay for observability, middleware and governance; Helix for evaluation, optimization and hardening; Fabric for a consistent agent-harness execution interface.
Exact product maturity, deployment availability, licensing and feature parity must be checked before adapter implementation.
limitations: The deprecated toolkit must not be treated as a new integration target.
No independent comparative performance result is implied.
Does not establish that NVIDIA hardware, CUDA, semiconductor design or manufacturing can be replaced.

entries.product_or_portfolio: Gemini Robotics 2.5 and Gemini 4 Argon robotics research capabilities
entries.status_as_reported: Announced and rolling out to robotics partners.
claim_notes: Google reports evaluation across more than 200 tasks.
Google reports a 96% success rate for a specific Apptronik Apollo 2 automotive-kitting proof of concept on Mercedes-Benz production lines.
Google reports task-dependent success improvements and safety-steerability improvements in its evaluation setup.
limitations: All performance figures are provider-reported and task/setup-specific.
A partner proof of concept is not a fleet-wide reliability or safety certification.
Not directly comparable to text-only agents or enterprise workflow platforms.

entries.product_or_portfolio: Microsoft Foundry agent tracing and evaluation
entries.product_version: Build 2026 public-preview announcement; point release not specified
entries.status_as_reported: Foundry tracing and evaluations were announced as generally available; the Build 2026 expansion to any-framework integrations via OpenTelemetry was described as public preview.
claim_notes: Microsoft describes tracing, evaluation, monitoring and optimization across agents built with Microsoft Agent Framework, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI SDK and custom frameworks via OpenTelemetry.
limitations: Preview status and supported regions/features must be rechecked before use.
Telemetry coverage does not by itself prove semantic effect truth or independent reconstruction.
No claim is made that Foundry replaces PLM/MBSE, physical engineering, or all enterprise applications.

entries.product_version: AgentCore Evaluations GA 2026-03-31; Guardrails in AgentCore Policy announced 2026-06-17
entries.status_as_reported: Evaluations generally available; policy Guardrails announced for selected AWS regions.
claim_notes: AWS describes 13 built-in evaluators for response quality, safety, task completion and tool use, plus ground-truth and custom evaluators.
AWS describes Guardrails in AgentCore Policy for evaluating actions and gateway calls, with results logged through observability.
limitations: Region availability must be checked for each capability.
AWS product-specific policy/evaluation should be included as a competitive baseline, not treated as absent.
Provider telemetry and policy outputs still require independent task/effect adjudication in Luminous comparisons.

entries.product_or_portfolio: Semiconductor solutions and infrastructure software portfolio
entries.status_as_reported: Public company portfolio; not a single agent-orchestration product.
claim_notes: Broadcom's Q3 FY2026 announcement identifies the company as a provider of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions and reports $29.6B quarterly revenue, up 86% year over year.
limitations: Revenue growth is not a technical performance benchmark.
A portfolio/company-level comparison is not equivalent to comparing one agent product.
No claim that Luminous can replace custom silicon, semiconductor manufacturing, or VMware is made.

entries.product_or_portfolio: Space, Connectivity and Super Intelligence operating portfolio
entries.status_as_reported: Operating company and industrial reference case; not a plug-compatible enterprise agent platform.
claim_notes: The Q3 2026 filing reports Space, Connectivity and Super Intelligence segments and 1.7 GW nameplate compute as of 2026-09-30.
limitations: SEC-filed company information is not evidence of Luminous/SpaceX technical interoperability.
Use SpaceX as an engineering and infrastructure reference case, not as a directly comparable software vendor.
Rocket, satellite and manufacturing capability depends on physical facilities, capital, qualified personnel and flight/field evidence.

entries.status_as_reported: Standards and research initiative; not a completed certification regime.
claim_notes: NIST's stated focus includes fostering interoperable and secure AI agents, industry-led standards and research into authentication and identity infrastructure.
limitations: The initiative is not itself a technical conformance standard or product certification.
Map Luminous interfaces to emerging standards as they stabilize; do not claim compliance from conceptual similarity.

claim_notes: The authors identify shortcut solvability, weak statistical significance, benchmark overfitting and data-source dependence as failure modes in manipulation evaluation, and audit LIBERO, CALVIN, SimplerEnv, RoboCasa and RoboTwin 2.0.
limitations: A benchmark audit is not a physical-robot performance result.
Use the diagnostics as methodological checks; inspect the paper and released artefacts before adopting its conclusions.
